title: The Stone Holding Still While Electricity Dances

features.name: exposed bedrock
features.desc-on-touch: You touch stone that has not moved in geological time. It is warm from the sun and patient. Electricity runs through it like a conversation it cannot answer.

features.name: circuit scar
features.desc-on-touch: Lightning once danced here and left its signature: a hair-thin white line through dark rock, where electricity learned that stone doesn't learn back.

features.name: node in stone
features.desc-on-touch: The solar panel sits in a crevice. The antenna is threaded through bark. The stone holds the whole device without complaint, without change, without memory.

features.name: time-carved pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water has sat here in the stone for centuries, working slowly. The pool reflects the sky but the stone remembers the stone. That is how time wins: by not moving at all.

features.name: root below
features.desc-on-touch: Deep in the stone, root-channels have split the bedrock over decades. The electricity passes through stone, the stone passes into the growing tree. Neither changes the other. Both persist.

inscription: the stone holds everything: electricity, time, the weight of learning not to move

file.name: Survey_MineralResistance_Limestone_1962.txt
file.note: Geological survey data. How much current the stone accepts without breaking. The answer is: all of it. No change. No record of investigator.
